messages.subject: pushed truncation tests in stanc
parts:
Daniel and I put our heads together and I added
some tests to the parser and code generator so
that stanc will now flag and report errors in
attempting to use truncation for densities for
which we don't have a CDF or attempt to use truncation
with vectorization, which we don't support (yet).

Longer-term, for efficiency and to make vectorization
simpler, we'll probably just roll truncation into the
probabilty functions, so we'd have functions that look
like:

normal_log(y,mu,sigma);
normal_lb_log(y,mu,sigma,L);
normal_ub_log(y,mu,sigma,H);
normal_lub_log(y,mu,sigma,L,H);

or with something longer if Andrew thinks "lb", "ub"
and "lub" are tacky and he can come up with better
alternatives :-)

- Bob
